item: Carbon abundance range across carbonaceous chondrites (per class)
notes: Sec 4.x ('Carbonaceous chondrites contain a wide range of carbon abundances from ~0.1 wt% for CK chondrites up to ~5 wt% carbon for the CI chondrites which is present in both organic and inorganic form')
column7: **DIRECT ANCHOR for our `carbon_fraction` rows**: TAXONOMY_COMPOSITION carries 22-30% carbon for B/C-complex — that is ~4-6x ABOVE even the most carbon-rich real C-type (CI at ~5 wt%). The pipeline's fraction therefore cannot be read as bulk elemental carbon; it must represent a broader 'carbon-bearing material' definition. Recorded here so any future re-calibration starts from measured per-class values instead of the current defaults
